chunks: And in the narration of Samāʿah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
There is no harm in it if the blood flows.

key_terms.سَمَاعَةَ: Samāʿah, the narrator transmitting this report
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: When is there no problem with hunted or slaughtered meat according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling related to hunting and slaughtering, indicating permissibility when blood flows. The flowing of blood is presented as the relevant sign for the ruling in this context.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4170 - In the narration of Samaah from Abu Abdillah (as), Imam (as) said:
"There is no harm in it if the blood flows."
